Stage one is decipher. The whole job of deciphering is to make them say the problem out loud. This is going to be on a call. So you want to talk maybe 20% of the time, have them talk the other 80% and just figure out what exactly are they struggling with? Where are their issues? How can you help them?
That'll lead us into stage two, which is the offer.
This is you by yourself writing this down, talking to Claude, talking to an LLM, trying to figure out
how to arrange what they told you
into what somebody would actually buy.

the whole point is to figure out, okay, well,
